root_cause: scripts/brain/ was simultaneously a shared executable prefix and a backend lane prefix. createDeliveryPlan therefore set sharedExecutable=true before lane resolution and activated backend, portal, website and automation for a small chat-learning control-plane regression change. This caused a full website build/browser crawl even though no website runtime changed.
prevention_rule: Generic scripts/brain/ is backend-owned, not shared executable. Exact scripts with explicit scoped ownership keep that ownership, including automation-only autonomous engineering scripts. Control-plane regression bundles must not activate portal or website unless a changed path is genuinely owned by those lanes.

evidence.structural_fix: remove scripts/brain/ from sharedPaths while retaining backend lane ownership and exact scoped ownership

evaluation.expected: generic scripts/brain work selects backend only; explicit scoped automation scripts remain automation only; no portal/website fanout
